title: across-refs cache: consult the blob store by oid on a manifest MISS (#763 round-5 nit 6)
description: Follow-up from the Opus round-5 review of #763 (nit 6), ruled by the leader as a follow-up after 0.15.1, no dependency on QCLI-577: on a manifest MISS the across-refs cache could consult the content-addressed blob store by blob oid before reading the blob from git, so a changed tree that shares most blobs with a cached one avoids re-reading them. Not a 0.15.1 gate. Read the verdict on QCLI-563 for the exact wording.

acceptanceCriteria.text: On a manifest MISS the read consults the blob store by oid for each path before reading it from git
A test shows a tree sharing blobs with a cached tree reads only the blobs the store does not hold
Cold-run and warm numbers at the shape C fixture are recorded on the task
